info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Settlement Adjustment API
info.description: The Settlement Adjustment API allows users to modify existing settlement records for payment processing. This API enables businesses to update details related to previously created settlements, ensuring accuracy and compliance in financial transactions. Typical consumers include financial institutions and accounting software that require real-time adjustment capabilities. Use cases may involve correcting discrepancies, updating status, or modifying details relevant to settlements, providing a seamless payment experience.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to modify the details of a specific settlement identified by its unique ID. Make sure to provide the necessary data in the request body to ensure successful updates.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update specific fields of the settlement identified by RES-100045. Ensure that only the fields that need to be modified are included in the request.
